items.source: Variant of RSocketRequester.Builder.tcp(String, int) and RSocketRequester.Builder.websocket(URI) with an already initialized ClientTransport.
items.translation: `RSocketRequester.Builder.tcp(String, int)` 和 `RSocketRequester.Builder.websocket(URI)` 的变体，使用已初始化的 `ClientTransport`。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an LoadbalanceRSocketClient that will connect to one of the given targets selected through the given LoadbalanceRSocketClient.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `LoadbalanceRSocketClient` 的RSocketRequester，该客户端将通过给定的 `LoadbalanceRSocketClient` 连接到给定目标中的一个。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over TCP to the given host and port.
items.translation: 构建一个使用 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 TCP 连接到指定的主机和端口。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over WebSocket to the given URL.
items.translation: 构建一个使用 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 WebSocket 连接到指定的 URL。

items.source: Return an RSocketServiceProxyFactory builder, initialized with the given client.
items.translation: 返回一个使用给定客户端初始化的RSocketServiceProxyFactory 构建器。

items.source: Uses of RSocketRequester in org.springframework.messaging.rsocket
items.translation: `org.springframework.messaging.rsocket` 包中 `RSocketRequester` 的用法

items.source: Uses of RSocketRequester in org.springframework.messaging.rsocket.service
items.translation: `org.springframework.messaging.rsocket.service` 中 `RSocketRequester` 的用法

items.source: Annotations to declare an RSocket service contract with request methods along with a proxy factory backed by an RSocketRequester.
items.translation: 用于声明带有请求方法的 RSocket 服务契约的注解，以及由 RSocketRequester 支持的代理工厂。

items.source: Provide the requester to perform requests through.
items.translation: 为请求者提供执行请求的途径。
